legend_notes: B3 EXPAND / B4 APPRAISE / B5 SELECT stay empty: with one active recall channel (substring match) there is nothing to fuse, rerank or select — results return sorted by created_at, capped by the caller's top_k.

B2 RECALL is rated ◐ not because the channel is inactive — Retrieval:Substring runs on every conversation_search call — but because it is the ONLY channel and carries no term weighting or relevance score, despite the tool's own docstring promising "hybrid search (text + semantic similarity)".

A4 INDEX's only occupant (archival embedding) is dead by default: DEPRECATED_LETTA_TOOLS strips archival_memory_insert/search from BASE_TOOLS. The one live exception is agent_create.enable_sleeptime, whose branch runs before the letta_v1_agent branch and keeps archival_memory_search attached.

Two internally-inconsistent compaction paths coexist in the same repo: default LettaAgentV3 uses compact_messages (token-based, 100%/90% of context window), while non-default LettaAgentV2/legacy uses Summarizer (message-count based, 30% evict) — same job, different thresholds, different default reachability.
